summary: Compare post-reorg world-soak state against fresh canonical replay
details: Capture all pass snapshots, economic profiles, ownership views, candidate sets, collab breakdowns and relevant owner balances immediately after each reorg and at finalization; include complete pass and balance histories in the final checkpoint.

Replay canonical Bitcoin data from genesis into separate empty balance-history and indexer databases, comparing pinned historical identities and every semantic field while excluding only local SQLite event sequence numbers.
Require a successful comparison for every reorg and the final checkpoint in weekly summaries. Retain recovery at the completed workload until replay succeeds, keeping all 2500 work rounds unchanged.
This checks rollback versus fresh replay using the same implementation; it is not an independently implemented protocol oracle or a clean rebuild of Ord.
